description:
Two legs of .github/workflows/nightly.yml are still non-blocking and now pass: the Windows integration-smoke leg (#2569) and scheduled-workflow-liveness (#2570). In every completed nightly.yml run from 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-09, all steps of both legs passed (for example run 37967682464). Judge each leg by step results, not job conclusion, because continue-on-error reports a failed job as success.

For each leg, remove continue-on-error and the quarantine suffix from its name, update any workflow tests that assert them, and close its issue with a comment linking the run and the fix. If a leg fails in a fresh dispatched run, it keeps its quarantine and gets a tracker item with the failing step.

Out of scope: the Windows 'test' legs (#2568). Leave their quarantine in nightly.yml until dlv2-70 retires nightly.yml. Their coverage and the closing of #2568 moved to nightly-v2-windows-unit-leg-20261009.
